ConfirmActiveRequest.description: Someone `V redakci` says they still are: resets `Poslední potvrzení` and clears `Dotaz odeslán`. Writes nothing for anyone else, and answers `not_active`.

idempotencyKey.description: Identifies one POST across its attempts. A repeat answers with the first result instead of writing again. Random per POST: a new press of a button is a new key, and the sheet decides.

idempotent.description: Present only on a repeat: an earlier call with this key did the work, and nothing was written now.

error.description: `not_found`: no named row on `Kontakty` has this address. `not_active`: the person is not `V redakci`. `ambiguous`: rows with different names share this address. `busy`: no lock in time, worth trying again.

EnrolRequest.description: Adds an application to `Přihlášky` as `Čeká na přijetí`, keyed by the address. One still waiting is refreshed. `Ověření e-mailu` is the day this request arrives. `Kontakty` is not touched.

formSubmittedAt.description: When the form was sent; its day lands in `Odeslání formuláře`.

idempotencyKey.description: Identifies one POST across its attempts. A repeat answers with the first result instead of writing again. Random per POST: a new press of a button is a new key, and the sheet decides.

interest.description: What the person would like to work on; lands in `Zájem o činnost`.

name.description: The full name on one line, without an address or a link.

Envelope.description: How a request travels. `payload` is a request serialised to a string and signed as that exact string. OWN_SECRET is the signing key and never leaves either end.

payload.description: JSON of an EnrolRequest, a ConfirmActiveRequest or a LeaveRequest.

timestamp.description: Unix seconds. Inside the signature, so it cannot be adjusted.

LeaveRequest.description: Sets `Stav` to `Mimo redakci` and `Odchod či vyřazení` to today, unless the person is already out with a date, and clears `Dotaz odeslán`. Never deletes a row.

idempotencyKey.description: Identifies one POST across its attempts. A repeat answers with the first result instead of writing again. Random per POST: a new press of a button is a new key, and the sheet decides.

description: Contract for the writes to the Vedneměsíčník editorial-board spreadsheet. POST a signed Envelope whose payload is an EnrolRequest, a ConfirmActiveRequest or a LeaveRequest; the response is an EditorialBoardMembershipResponse. Always replies HTTP 200, so `ok` is the only signal.
title: EditorialBoardMembership
